summary: Iteration 6 testing complete for TableTaap Manager Dashboard. Backend: 6/6 new iter6 tests pass — /api/subscription GET returns all deferred fields (pending_tables, pending_subtotal, pending_total, cycle_start, next_cycle_start); POST state machine works (first-time → applied:'immediate' with trial dates + cycle_start ~now + next_cycle_start ~30d; existing+diff tables → applied:'next_cycle' with pending_* set and current tables UNCHANGED; existing+same tables → applied:'no_change' clears pending; tables<10/>60 → 400). /api/stats/revenue?period=week returns 7 entries with label='DD Mon' (e.g., '10 Jun') and weekday='Mon'. Iter5 regression: 16/17 still pass — the 1 failure (test_post_subscription_saves) is expected because iter6 changed POST response schema (no longer returns 'subtotal' for next_cycle deferred path). Frontend: top-clock shows 'Jun 10 · 07:36 PM' (month + date + time) ✓; growth-pill displays ▲+100% triangle inside .growth-tri (no lucide icons) ✓; ProfileSection shows subscription card with status='Free Trial', tables=20, total=₹1,532.82, next='14 Jun 2026', plus 'incl. 18% GST' caption ✓; profile-change-sub-btn navigates to /subscribe (NOT embedded) ✓; profile email label has '(optional)' and save with empty email works ✓; Subscribe page sub-change-notice banner shows current tables+monthly cost, slider pre-fills to 20, dynamic CTA 'Schedule change to 25 tables · effective —' shows correctly ✓; clicking subscribe POSTs and pending_tables=25 persists on backend (verified via GET /api/subscription) ✓; Signup brand-logo-wrap has white bg ✓. Tables occupied/empty CSS could not be programmatically verified end-to-end this run due to a 403 on the urllib order-creation helper (test scaffolding issue, NOT a real backend issue — backend /api/orders works via curl/pytest). Sales week X-axis query returned empty in two attempts (recharts width(-1) warnings repeat — same pre-existing issue noted in iter4/iter5; chart renders visually but tick text wasn't queryable within wait window).

minor.issue: When an existing sub was created pre-iter6 (no cycle_start/next_cycle_start), POST with new tables sets pending_* correctly but does NOT backfill cycle_start/next_cycle_start. Frontend then displays 'effective —' in the Subscribe CTA instead of a date. Suggest: on deferred path, if cycle_start is null, backfill from trial_start, and set next_cycle_start = trial_start + 30d. Verified GET /api/subscription still returns null for those fields.

Iter6 changed the 'next_cycle' response to drop 'subtotal'/'gst_amount' top-level keys (only sends current_tables, pending_tables, pending_total, next_cycle_start). This broke iter5 test_post_subscription_saves which expected 'subtotal' in response. Not a defect — schema change is intentional per spec — but document for downstream consumers.

integration_issues.issue: CTA reads 'Schedule change to 25 tables · effective —' (em dash) because backend next_cycle_start is null for legacy sub. UX gap — RCA above under backend minor issue.

issues: Recharts 'width(-1) and height(-1)' warnings still appear on initial mount of Sales tab (carry-over from iter4/iter5). Chart renders visually but DOM tick text was not queryable in two attempts during the wait window. Suggest forcing minHeight/minWidth on ResponsiveContainer.

action_items: Backfill cycle_start/next_cycle_start on POST /api/subscription deferred path when those fields are null (set cycle_start=trial_start; next_cycle_start=trial_start+30d). This will fix the Subscribe CTA showing 'effective —' instead of an actual date.
(Optional, low priority) Add explicit minHeight to Sales AreaChart ResponsiveContainer to silence recharts width(-1)/height(-1) warnings and make tick labels reliably renderable on first paint.

(Optional) Visually confirm Tables tab occupied/empty styling (gold gradient on occupied, dashed border on empty) — backend POST /api/orders verified working via pytest/curl; programmatic CSS check via urllib helper was blocked by a 403 (test scaffolding) so a quick manual screenshot pass is recommended.

rca of the issue: Subscribe CTA 'effective —' RCA: ProfileSection/Subscribe.jsx reads next_cycle_start from GET /api/subscription. For subs created in iter5 (before deferred fields existed), cycle_start/next_cycle_start are null in mongo. POST /subscription deferred branch reads existing.next_cycle_start with `or (now + 30d).isoformat()` for the RESPONSE only but does NOT write that fallback back to mongo. Fix: in the deferred update payload, include cycle_start = existing.cycle_start or trial_start or now.isoformat(), and next_cycle_start = existing.next_cycle_start or (that + 30d).isoformat(). One-line backfill resolves both the GET shape and the UI display.
